```python
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 1200]}
df_native = pl.DataFrame(data)
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

print(df.to_native())
```
